blocks.title: Platform as a Service (PaaS)
blocks.text: PaaS cloud mein mukammal development aur deployment mahol deta hai: infrastructure, middleware, development tools aur intezami services, ta ke developers hardware aur software ki tehein sambhale baghair coding par tawajjo dein.
Google App Engine developers ko kai programming languages mein applications banane aur deploy karne deta hai; Microsoft Azure App Services aur Heroku doosri misalein hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsi service infrastructure se nimte baghair applications banane, chalane aur sambhalne ka platform deti hai (MCQ 8)?

items: PaaS: apps banane aur deploy karne ka tayyar platform (Google App Engine, Heroku).
